lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns beginning posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the centroids of the high-luminance blobs to form a consistent grid-like anchor pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the upper edge and defined shadowing below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, vertical linear feature is observed on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gill region, intersecting the spot constellation.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin relative to the lateral flank spacing.
